summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Package @or-sdk/idw declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub oven-sh releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a shipped 727 KB file math_init.js. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (string-array with array-rotation index reconstruction) and carries a @bun / @bun-cjs banner indicating it will only run under Bun, bypassing Node-based tooling. setup.mjs itself uses hex-numeric variable names and per-call string alias objects (e.g. mapping to "/etc/os-release") to conceal its behavior. The package presents itself as a TypeScript IDW API client, a purpose that does not require pulling an alternate language runtime at install time. The combination of an npm lifecycle hook that fetches a second runtime, an obfuscated payload distinct from the advertised functionality, and execution of that payload under the freshly downloaded runtime constitutes install-time arbitrary code execution on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
